summary: Local Herd preview gets an Intranet-style developer sign-in and role changer for the three demo accounts, gated by DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED.
detailed_changes: Fixed local role preview 404s when demo users were missing; GET /_dev is available when enabled (#812).
Developer sign-in requires APP_ENV=local and DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED, with safe return paths, audit logging, post-switch fallback and Herd setup enabling the flag (#813).
Feature tests cover enablement, create-if-missing, switch, sign-out, return path and audit (#814).
Change Log Hub entry for this release (#815).
affected_areas: User groups affected: developers using Laravel Herd
Internal impact: reliable Public/Staff/Admin preview without Cloudron OIDC
